text: Removed Resource Requests from Control — sidebar tab, UI panels, server/client request handlers and resource-request configuration are no longer included.

Stations and appliance states — every configured callsign is now displayed, including OFF RUN entries; green=available, red=mobile/at incident, grey=off run. Added missing active J27P6 to Coldstream configuration.
Control live views — dashboard now renders live counters/incidents/appliances, and Stations lists every configured callsign grouped by station with grey/green/red operational states.
Control JavaScript — removed a leftover duplicated message-renderer block that prevented Command Suite renderCommandViews from being global and caused the startup ReferenceError.
Control JavaScript — repaired the message renderer so Command Suite functions remain global and renderCommandViews is defined when tabs open.
Control Command UI — Resource Requests, Stations, Appliance Board and Handover now render on tab open and request fresh live data, preventing blank panes.
Control empty-state panels — Dashboard, Appliance Board, Stations, Resource Requests and Shift Handover now show useful live/empty states instead of blank screens.
Resource configuration — added editable resource types and callsign resource categories, with Control filtering/mobilisation of matching available appliances.
Control Command Upgrade — live dashboard, appliance board presentation, station grouping, resource request tab, incident timeline, and shift handover summary.
Control configuration — uploaded Config.Callsigns, Config.AlertVehicles and Config.CallSignStations kept exactly as supplied.

SatNav 2.0 — Added an expanded offline map system with live GPS position, follow mode, map styles, search, GIS grid layer, route/measure tools, north arrow, scale bar, live GPS status and improved map controls.
Update History — Added a full in-game Update History tab opened from SatNav Admin Menu, matching the history stored in the resource files.
Update History — Added a persistent MDT update history showing date, time and work completed.
Keyboard shortcuts — F4 opens the MDT and F6 opens Control. Existing /getec and /control commands remain available.
Messaging — Control and MDT messages now use one shared conversation.
Pager — Pager popup and Enter-to-close behaviour fixed.
Incident alerts — Incidents continue to arrive on the MDT when the alert sound is disabled.
Control appliance list — Callsigns now synchronise correctly with Control.
Admin Menu — Battery Status, Screen Settings and About panels restored.
